summary: Iteration 44: Backend-only testing of Feed Reactions System, Liga Assessorias, and Ranking Corridas endpoints. All 23 tests passed. The reactions system correctly replaced the likes system with 7 reaction types.
critical_code_review_comments: Reactions system correctly implemented with 7 types: aplausos, corrida, forca, fogo, coracao, festa, trofeu
GET /api/feed/posts/{post_id}/reacoes returns reactions grouped by type with user info
GET /api/feed returns posts with reacoes dict, total_reacoes, and minha_reacao fields
MongoDB collection changed from feed_curtidas to feed_reacoes
seed_data_creation: Created test posts for reaction testing (prefixed with TEST_)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All reactions endpoints verified working. The feed now uses reactions instead of likes. Tests created test posts prefixed with TEST_ that should be cleaned up eventually.
